title: The LV2 adapter has an agent skill, and that skill carries an explicit Vellum-boundary disposition

needles: Transport arrives as an atom, on the MIDI port

installed_sdk.rationale: A skill is agent-facing guidance and an inventory row is a boundary classification. Neither adds a header, type, parameter or callable surface, and the LV2 adapter behaves exactly as it did before either landed.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No command, flag or projection changes.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool, request or response shape changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No operation, executor binding, grant or profile policy is added.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time capability row is added or changed. The Vellum disposition records that this plug-in-format surface sits outside the audio-free framework boundary, which is an ownership statement rather than an advertised capability.
